claims.text: Peripheral IV: fluids, medications, blood draws.
Common sites: median cubital, cephalic, basilic, external jugular; use the non-dominant arm.
claims.quote: sites: any peripheral site - MC: median cubital, cephalic, basilic, external jugular - use non-dominant extremity

claims.text: Intraosseous: rapid access when all else fails (arrest, trauma, shock).
claims.quote: indication: RAPID access when all else fails (arrest, trauma, shock)

claims.text: All medications, even blood products (with ≥18 g), can be given IO.
claims.quote: ALL meds (even blood products if ≥18 g used) can be given IO

claims.text: Ports: always sterile technique to access; flush with every use.
claims.quote: ALWAYS sterile technique when accessing - ± blood draws - flush w EVERY use

claims.text: Central line indications: pressors, antibiotics, chemo, volume or hypertonic saline, CVP monitoring, transvenous pacing.
claims.quote: indications: meds (pressors, abx, chemo) - fluids (volume, hypertonic saline) - central venous monitoring (CVP, ScvO₂) - transvenous pacing (TVP)

claims.text: Complications: vascular injury, infection, pneumothorax, bleeding, air embolism.
claims.quote: complications: vascular injury - infection - PTX - bleeding - air embolism

claims.text: Seldinger: needle and guidewire → dilator over the wire → catheter over the wire → remove the wire.
claims.quote: 1) venipuncture w guidewire insertion → 2) advancement of dilator over guidewire → 3) placement of catheter over guidewire → 4) remove guidewire, catheter remains in vessel
IJ (internal jugular): US guidance → reduces complications (hemo/pneumothorax, arterial injury)

claims.text: Place an IJ line at 17 cm and get a post-placement CXR.
Subclavian: higher risk of pneumothorax and arterial injury.
claims.quote: subclavian: HIGHER risk of pneumothorax + arterial injury

claims.text: Femoral: short-term only, high infection risk.
claims.quote: femoral: SHORT-TERM placement only - high risk of infection

claims.text: CLABSI bundle: hand hygiene, maximal sterile barriers, >0.5% chlorhexidine-alcohol skin prep.
claims.quote: bundle components: 1) hand hygiene before insertion - 2) maximal sterile barrier precautions (cap, mask, sterile gown + gloves, full-body drape) - 3) >0.5% chlorhexidine w alcohol skin prep
